runtime_status: No source connection, export role, telemetry change or production transfer executed in H04.
purpose: Internal Renvani platform reporting of economics, activation, observed outcomes, quantitative AI usage/cost and data health.
policy_precedence: Actual verified processing authority and company/record/purpose eligibility are required before any export.
A source-side positive projection selects only listed fields; do not spread, serialize or forward a full source row.
Validate the outgoing payload as a closed schema recursively. Unknown outgoing fields, object keys, token values or unsupported versions fail closed.
An internally valid H03 or RCI record is not automatically permitted externally; this independent field/purpose policy is narrower.
Field names newly added to H03 or a provider schema are denied until this policy version and owner review explicitly include them.
Permissioned query and download output is no broader than the source fields, dataset audience and declared metric purpose.
Allowed opaque identifiers remain confidential/pseudonymous business data; neither hashing nor grouping establishes anonymity or learning rights.

destination_contract.logical_destination: Restricted Renvani internal PostHog analytics organization/project
destination_contract.environment_isolation: Production and nonproduction use separate recorded project/source configuration; synthetic data only in preparation.
destination_contract.secondary_destinations: No public sharing, scheduled external messages, new destination, vendor AI processing path or pooled learning export without its own recorded purpose and effective grants.

value_constraints.registered_tokens: Values must come from an owner-reviewed finite registry or deterministic adapter mapping, with bounded length. A string matching a token regex is not sufficient if it contains customer text.
value_constraints.opaque_identifiers: Use server-issued canonical IDs or verified provider object IDs in their account/mode/type namespace. Exclude raw imported sourceId strings, arbitrary URLs, user-entered references, secrets and contact-based identifiers.
value_constraints.strings: No free-form names, descriptions, summaries, notes, prompts, query text, exception messages, tool descriptions or arbitrary metadata.
value_constraints.amounts: Exact string representations, explicit original currency/exponent or decimal scale, no float conversion; monetary values do not confer permission to read the source contact details.
value_constraints.timestamps: UTC instants or explicitly validated IANA timezone identifiers from H03/H02; never silently change retention anchors on reingestion.
value_constraints.nulls: Preserve required null/unknown states under H03/H02. Do not replace a denied field with a fake zero or fabricate a required reference.
value_constraints.array_objects: Every object in an array is recursively closed; an allowed array name does not permit arbitrary payloads inside it.
value_constraints.unknown_cutoff: source_cutoff_at is present and may be null only as an explicit unknown coverage state under H03; null requires freshness unknown and cannot support a complete/reconciled-current metric. Never substitute ingestion or wall-clock time.

conditional_restrictions.rule: Must be server-verified and permitted for internal reporting. Null is allowed only for H03 explicit platform-health/shared-cost cases, never for accepted tenant facts.

conditional_restrictions.applies_to: Every source_ref, related_source_refs[], pricing_evidence_ref, first_value_source_ref and entity_ref
conditional_restrictions.rule: Approved company, connected merchant account, observability project, source configuration/run/check, estimate/option-set, job, invoice, payment, financial component, platform subscription/price/product, workflow/action, approved import batch or cost pool reference only. End-customer, staff/user, pay-period, personal-contact, payment-method, bank/card and arbitrary document subjects are denied. The narrowly defined platform_billing_customer exception is H04-F03.

Only a verified platform_billing_customer mapping to companies.stripeCustomerId may use the opaque Stripe customer ID for company subscription classification. customers.stripeCustomerId for a merchant end customer is excluded. No Customer object payload is allowed.

Optional only when needed for an accepted card and supported by approved coarse registry values. Region is coarse company geography, not address, postcode, GPS or customer service location; exact staff counts, names and payroll are excluded.
Opaque lineage pointers and timing only. No feature payload or source document is permitted by these fields; no cross-company training right is implied.

conditional_restrictions.applies_to: failure_class, disposition_code, selection_reason_code, adjustment_reason_code, source_event_type, workflow/model/trace labels
conditional_restrictions.rule: Registered controlled categories only. Map errors to a safe code at source; do not export raw errorMessage, stack, provider request/response body, customer content or user-supplied span/tool name.

Only configured-source/run/check metadata, quality state and aggregate exception counts/amounts. Raw unmapped objects, account-holder contact details, connection strings, host credentials and diagnostic payloads stay out.
Finance/cost detail grants are separate from general workflow dashboard access. Source-account/company scope, currency and basis remain visible; exposed amounts must satisfy the H02 classification.
Bound cardinality in the implementation; only approved reference/token types. Exporting every source object or arbitrary tags is denied. Assists remain non-additive.
Retain only mapping histories needed by active permitted records. User identity/actor details and entire company settings objects are not mapping fields.

company requires a verified non-null company_id; platform requires company_id null and a separately accepted internal platform-cost grant. An unresolved tenant mapping is never relabeled platform cost.

No free-form aggregate schema is implicitly approved by a retention profile. C12/H06 must bind a closed minimized aggregate schema, accepted metric and retention purpose before materialization. Otherwise older detail expiry produces explicit unavailable/partial coverage.

query_manifest_ref is an opaque handle to an immutable internal record binding the exact resolved company set/population snapshot, actual filter values/definition, period/timezone/currency/environment/account-mode, source revisions/cutoffs and producing authorization context. None of that internal context is implicitly exported. Missing/incomplete or mutable-only manifest blocks a complete/reproducible result; missing verified access scope denies output rather than broadening it. Current query/drill-through access must be reauthorized; the handle never grants permission.
query_output_contract.retention_profile: RET-EXPORT for downloaded copies; underlying data keeps its profile
query_output_contract.result_shape_binding_status: H06/C06/C11 must bind exact closed per-metric result schemas before an output is enabled. The listed scalar fields are candidate output families, not an approval of arbitrary vectors or JSON.

vendor_transport_binding.credential_rule: Credential/project-token transport fields are handled through the approved secret/configuration mechanism and are not business/event properties or stored reporting fields.
vendor_transport_binding.automatic_metadata_rule: Inspect actual emitted and stored payloads, including provider/SDK-added fields and failure/stream paths. Record any required protocol metadata explicitly before enabling native capture; no broad metadata exception.
vendor_transport_binding.record_requirement: Changing producer/SDK/source configuration requires renewed payload-diff and schema review before new fields can flow.

native_connector_decisions.decision: Expose only approved reporting projections under a dedicated read-only export identity, select exact fields, inspect mandatory key/cursor columns and defaults. Base tables and SELECT * are not approved.

Inspect full resource and nested payload schema before transfer. Managed-schema Stripe masking and API row filters are not supported by current docs. Exclude resources with denied fields; use a sanitized Renvani-side financial projection when native cannot meet the policy. Hiding downstream fields is insufficient.
Choose one primary path, inspect and allowlist every exported property. Privacy mode alone does not remove custom names/properties/tool descriptions. Whole-trace import is not approved.
